basis: No sector cybersecurity rule binds an independent recruiter (NAICS 561320); CSF 2.0 is used as the voluntary benchmark for the whole business

obligation: Florida Information Protection Act (reasonable measures, breach notice, disposal)
basis: A "covered entity" includes a sole proprietorship that acquires, maintains, stores or uses personal information (501.171(1)(b)), with no headcount or revenue threshold. The owner holds SSNs, dates of birth and ID images of Florida residents in the mailbox, the laptop and the phone, and enters SSNs in the partner portal

The rule reaches any person that possesses "consumer information" for a business purpose, including a consumer report or a record derived from one (682.1(b), 682.2(b)). Two client-forwarded background check reports are in the mailbox, and the partner portal shows clearance statuses

The owner does not procure consumer reports: the partner orders them for contractors under its own FCRA certification and shows only a clearance status, and clients order their own for direct hires. No payment to a background screening company appears in the statements

References to recruiters and referrers for a fee are limited to agricultural associations, agricultural employers and farm labor contractors (274a.2(a)(1)). The business is none of these and has no employees; the partner completes Forms I-9 for contractors and clients complete them for direct hires
Applies to private employers with 25 or more employees; the business has none
Job orders are for IT support, accounting and data analyst roles; there are no clinical placements and no services for covered entities involving PHI
The owner texts candidates one at a time from the phone and does not telemarket; no dialer or texting platform appears in the statements. TCPA consent details were not analyzed

citation: PCI Security Standards Council standard (contractual, not law)
basis: The business accepts no payment cards: the partner pays the margin share by ACH and direct-hire clients pay invoices by ACH or check

obligation: FAR Basic Safeguarding clause (and FAR 52.240-93 under an agency's FAR Part 40 class deviation)
basis: No federal contracts or subcontracts; every client is a private Florida employer

obligation: NYC Local Law 144 (Automated Employment Decision Tools)
basis: No NYC jobs or candidates for NYC jobs: every job order is for a Florida client. Re-check before taking a job order outside Florida or for a remote role (P10)
The business does not offer or transport hazardous materials; it works from a home office

obligation: Title VII: employment agency practices and disparate impact
basis: An employment agency is "any person regularly undertaking with or without compensation to procure employees for an employer" (2000e(c)), with no headcount test for the agency. The owner fills about 40 job orders a year for about 15 clients that each list 50 to 500 employees (so each is an employer under 2000e(b)). Applies to the AI match add-on
An employment agency is a covered entity under 12111(2). Selection criteria that screen out people with disabilities must be job related
Same employment agency test for age (630(c)); the add-on's inputs include years of experience and employment gaps

Start forms and ID images in the mailbox include people who live in 6 states other than Florida (EV-SI-12, counted 2026-07-23). Each state's trigger and deadline is confirmed by counsel at the time of an incident

obligation: Client fee agreements (confidentiality and incident notice)
basis: Each fee agreement covers client information with a confidentiality clause and requires notice of a security incident affecting client information "promptly"
General confidentiality clause; the agreement sets no security requirements and no breach notice period

obligation: CIRCIA covered cyber incident and ransom payment reports
basis: Not a final rule; the business would not be covered as proposed. Tracked for planning
The business is a sole proprietorship, not a public company

citation: OFAC ransomware advisory (2021-09-21); 31 CFR ch. V
applies: Yes (only if a payment is considered)
